geneList.name: label
geneList.documentation: A human-readable label for this gene list (e.g. 'Opossum SAW bin1 GEF genes').

geneList.name: n_genes
geneList.documentation: The number of data rows in genes.tsv. Every gene_index referring to this list must be less than this value.

geneList.name: species
geneList.documentation: The species the annotation describes, preferably as an ontology node (e.g. 'NCBITaxon:9265').

geneList.name: gene_id_namespace
geneList.documentation: The identifier system used in the gene_id column (e.g. 'Ensembl', 'NCBI', 'FlyBase'). Two gene lists in different namespaces cannot be compared without a geneListMapping.

geneList.name: gene_symbol_namespace
geneList.documentation: The identifier system used in the gene_name column (e.g. 'HGNC', 'MGI', ''). May be empty if symbols are absent or unofficial.

geneList.name: annotation_source
geneList.documentation: Identifier of the genome annotation (GTF/GFF) this list came from, including any modification. Counts are not reproducible without it.

geneList.name: gene_name_completeness
geneList.documentation: Fraction of rows with a non-empty gene_name. Stereo-seq GEFs commonly leave 10-20 percent of symbols blank; a reader that keys on symbols must know this.
